_meta.description: T4 advanced engine feature — reconciliation sessions, reports, and variance aggregations on top of the T2 bookkeeping-bank-reconciliation matching engine. ADR-031 declarative: lifecycle, aggregations, manifest-only rendering; one PHP guard (StatementVerifyGuard) per ADR-031 §exception for GL-balance lookup that the declarative engine cannot express.
_meta.dedup-note: T4 is the OUTCOME RECORDER, not a matcher. The bank-statement-line ↔ AR/AP/GL match decision is owned by T2 bookkeeping-bank-reconciliation (its MatchingRule register, x-openregister-aggregations on ReconciliationMatch, and the operator-confirm lifecycle). T4 consumes T2's confirm event via ReconciliationMatchToReportListener and stamps the BankReconciliation session (reconId) + resolution semantics (resolutionStatus/resolutionReason for unmatched items) on the same ReconciliationMatch register. There is intentionally no parallel match table, no T4 matching algorithm, and no VarianceReportService — REQ-REC-007 variance is pure x-openregister-aggregations metadata on closed sessions. Verified against lib/Service/* on 2026-06-09: no Reconcil*Engine, no Variance*Service, no BankMatch* mapper, no parallel reconciliation Db classes.

BankReconciliation.title: Bank Reconciliation
BankReconciliation.description: A bounded reconciliation session for one bank account + one statement period. Captures opening/closing balances, expected GL balance, computed variance, lifecycle status (draft → in-progress → verified → closed), preparer/verifier signatures, and the closedAt timestamp. NOT a live dashboard — an immutable audit artifact once closed. Per ADR-022/ADR-031 declarative-first: matching is delegated to the T2 bookkeeping-bank-reconciliation engine; T4 records outcomes and closes the audit loop.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every lifecycle transition (preparer, verifier, sign-off comment, timestamp) appended to an immutable audit trail per ADR-022.

bankAccountId.description: FK to the bank account / IBAN this reconciliation belongs to.
bankAccountId.title: Bank Account ID

statementDate.description: The statement issue date (period-end date by convention).
statementDate.title: Statement Date

statementPeriodStart.description: First day of the reconciliation period (inclusive).
statementPeriodStart.title: Statement Period Start

statementPeriodEnd.description: Last day of the reconciliation period (inclusive).
statementPeriodEnd.title: Statement Period End

openingBalance.description: Statement opening balance in account currency. Stored as a decimal but compared in integer cents per ADR-005 server-authority and to avoid IEEE-754 drift.
openingBalance.title: Opening Balance

closingBalance.description: Statement closing balance in account currency. Compared against expectedGLBalance to compute variance.
closingBalance.title: Closing Balance

expectedGLBalance.description: Expected GL balance computed formula: Account.balanceAtPeriodStart + SUM(GLLine.debit - GLLine.credit) for the period. Server-authoritative — populated by StatementVerifyGuard, never trusted from the client.
expectedGLBalance.title: Expected GL Balance

variance.description: |closingBalance - expectedGLBalance|. Server-derived. Zero when statement and GL agree; positive when they disagree (timing differences, adjustments, errors).
variance.title: Variance

reconciliationStatus.description: Lifecycle state. See x-openregister-lifecycle for the transition map and guards.
reconciliationStatus.title: Reconciliation Status

preparedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the operator who initiated the reconciliation. Populated on the `initiate` transition.
preparedBy.title: Prepared By

verifiedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the verifier who confirmed all unmatched items resolved. Populated on the `verify` transition.
verifiedBy.title: Verified By

closedAt.description: UTC datetime when the reconciliation transitioned `verified → closed`. Once set, no further edits.
closedAt.title: Closed At

signOffComment.description: Verifier sign-off note required on `in-progress → verified`. Empty value blocks the transition.
signOffComment.title: Sign Off Comment

matchedCount.description: Server-derived count of ReconciliationMatch records with resolutionStatus=matched for this session. Updated by the lifecycle engine on every match write.
matchedCount.title: Matched Count

unmatchedGLCount.description: Server-derived count of GL transactions in the statement period without a confirmed match.
unmatchedGLCount.title: Unmatched GL Count

unmatchedBankCount.description: Server-derived count of bank statement lines without a confirmed match.
unmatchedBankCount.title: Unmatched Bank Count

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this reconciliation. Scopes uniqueness of (bankAccountId, statementPeriodEnd).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Operator has initialised the reconciliation but has not yet begun matching. Editable; statement balance has not been verified.

in-progress.label: In Progress
in-progress.description: Statement balance verified; operator is matching transactions and resolving unmatched items. T2 match events accepted.

verified.label: Verified
verified.description: All matches confirmed and all unmatched items resolved; verifier has signed off. Awaiting period close.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Period closed; reconciliation immutable. Appears in variance aggregations. No further edits.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Operator abandoned the reconciliation from draft. Audit-trailed but excluded from aggregations.

initiate.label: Initiate reconciliation
initiate.description: Verify statement balance and unlock matching. The guard recomputes expectedGLBalance + variance server-side; non-zero variance surfaces a warning but does not block the transition (scenario 'variance surfaces warning but allows proceed').

verify.label: Verify reconciliation
verify.description: Confirm all unmatched items have been classified (timing/pending/adjustment/matched) AND the verifier has supplied a sign-off comment. The guard rejects the transition when unresolved matches remain or signOffComment is empty.

close.label: Close reconciliation
close.description: Stamp closedAt and lock the reconciliation. After this transition the session is immutable; corrections require opening a new reconciliation for a later period.

cancel.label: Cancel reconciliation
cancel.description: Operator abandons an unstarted reconciliation. Audit-trailed but excluded from aggregations.

revert.label: Revert for investigation
revert.description: Operator returns an in-progress reconciliation to draft to redo statement verification. All matches recorded so far are retained but the statement-balance verification must run again on the next initiate.

varianceByAccount.description: Total absolute variance per bank account across all closed reconciliations. Open reconciliations are excluded (scenario 'variance aggregation excludes open reconciliations').

varianceByPeriod.description: Variance by (bankAccountId, statementPeriodEnd). Used for trend analysis — accountants spot drift across multiple closing periods.

reconciliationCount.description: Number of closed reconciliations per account.

ReconciliationMatch.description: T4 extension of the T2 ReconciliationMatch schema declared in add-shillinq-bookkeeping-compliance. T4 adds reconId (FK to BankReconciliation session), matchAlgorithm (exact/fuzzy/manual — T4 supports exact + manual only per), matchedAt timestamp, manualOverride, resolutionStatus + resolutionReason (unmatched-item resolution), and the AR/AP shortcut FKs (arInvoiceId, apTransactionId). Pre-existing T2 fields (matchId, bankStatementLineId, matchType, matchedObjectId, status, confirmedBy, confirmedAt, rejectedReason) are preserved untouched — this fragment deep-merges per ADR-037.

reconId.description: FK to the BankReconciliation session this match belongs to. Empty when the match was emitted before T4 sessions existed (legacy T2-only records).
reconId.title: Recon ID

glTransactionId.description: FK to GLTransaction.id. Null for bank-only matches (statement line with no GL counterpart — handled via resolutionStatus).
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

bankLineId.description: FK to BankStatementLine.lineId. Alias of T2's bankStatementLineId for the T4 session schema; populated by the T2→T4 event consumer.
bankLineId.title: Bank Line ID

matchAlgorithm.description: Algorithm that produced the match. T4 supports `exact` (T2 rules engine) and `manual` (operator override). `fuzzy` is reserved for T5.
matchAlgorithm.title: Match Algorithm

confidenceScoreT4.description: Confidence in [0.0, 1.0] for the T4 record. 1.0 = certain; <0.9 = low-confidence (operator review recommended). Distinct from the T2 confidenceScore so legacy fragments do not clash.
confidenceScoreT4.title: Confidence Score T4

matchedAt.description: When the T4 ReconciliationMatch record was created. Distinct from T2's confirmedAt (which is the operator-confirm timestamp).
matchedAt.title: Matched At

manualOverride.description: True when the match was operator-created (or operator-corrected from an auto-match) scenario 'Operator manually matches GL transaction to bank line'.
manualOverride.title: Manual Override

resolutionStatus.description: Classification of unmatched items. `matched` = operator manually matched; `timing` = expected to match in next period; `pending` = awaiting bank/GL confirmation; `adjustment` = non-transaction difference (fee, accrual). Null while the operator has not yet classified.
resolutionStatus.title: Resolution Status

resolutionReason.description: Operator-supplied reason for the resolution classification (audit-trailed). Required when resolutionStatus is set.
resolutionReason.title: Resolution Reason

arInvoiceId.description: FK to ARInvoice.id when the match is AR-based. Semantic shortcut to T2's polymorphic matchedObjectId for query convenience.
arInvoiceId.title: AR Invoice ID

apTransactionId.description: FK to APInvoice/APTransaction id when the match is AP-based. Semantic shortcut to T2's polymorphic matchedObjectId.
apTransactionId.title: AP Transaction ID

matchesByRecon.description: Number of ReconciliationMatch records per reconciliation session. Drives BankReconciliation.matchedCount.

varianceByType.description: Variance-by-type aggregation: count of unmatched items by classification (timing/pending/adjustment). Excludes resolved 'matched' items.

unresolvedByRecon.description: Count of unmatched (resolutionStatus=null) entries per reconciliation. Drives the pre-close summary.

ReconciliationReport.title: Reconciliation Report
ReconciliationReport.description: A signed-off audit artifact captured when a BankReconciliation transitions verified → closed. Records the matched/unmatched counts, total variance, preparer + verifier UIDs, and the verifier sign-off comment for permanent retention. Immutable once created.

reconId.description: FK to the BankReconciliation this report finalises.
reconId.title: Recon ID

reportDate.description: UTC datetime the report was sealed. Mirrors the parent's closedAt.
reportDate.title: Report Date

unmatchedGLCount.description: Final count of unmatched GL transactions (timing + pending + adjustment classifications retained for audit).
unmatchedGLCount.title: Unmatched GL Count

unmatchedBankCount.description: Final count of unmatched bank lines.
unmatchedBankCount.title: Unmatched Bank Count

totalVariance.description: Final |closingBalance - expectedGLBalance|. Server-derived from the parent reconciliation at close time.
totalVariance.title: Total Variance

preparedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the operator who prepared the reconciliation (mirrors parent BankReconciliation.preparedBy).
preparedBy.title: Prepared By

verifiedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the verifier who signed off (mirrors parent BankReconciliation.verifiedBy).
verifiedBy.title: Verified By

signOffComment.description: Verifier sign-off note copied from the parent reconciliation at close time.
signOffComment.title: Sign Off Comment

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this report. Mirrors parent reconciliation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

totalVarianceByAdmin.description: Total variance booked across all closed reconciliations per administration. Drives the variance dashboard.
